title: Quests_(Kanto)
lead_summary: The game includes several sidequests that gives the player rewards for completing them, 85 total. The player can view their ongoing and completed quests in the Quest Journal item.
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.
raw_wikitext:
The game includes several sidequests that gives the player rewards for completing them, 85 total. The player can view their ongoing and completed quests in the Quest Journal item. ==Types of quest== There are four types of quests. Each has a specific color which the quest title will be displayed using in the Quest Journal. The first one can be found in Vermillion City, in the house just east of the Pokémon Center. The second one can be found on the second floor of the Daycare Center south of Cerulean City.
